description.name: Entry
description.text: Ten single attacks (0.71 each), grants [Last Stand] and [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 3] to all allies, grants [Attach Ice] and [Avenging Fist Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Last Stand
description.text: If HP reaches 0, prevents [KO] restoring HP for 1% maximum HP, removed after triggering

description.name: 40% Damage Reduction Barrier 3
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 40% for the next three attacks

description.name: Attach Ice
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Ice damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Ice resistance +20%

description.name: Avenging Fist Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Avenging Fist when any Damage Reduction Barrier is removed
